ecashMelt(address,uint256,bytes32).details: Deliberately no pause check anywhere on this path: withdrawals are      never pausable. Holders must always be able to exit.

params.meltId: The mint's melt quote id; one payout per meltId.

ecashMint(uint256,bytes32).details: Also gated on the publication policy's interval rule: a mint whose      solvency attestation is overdue cannot take new allowance deposits.      (Memo-path deposits are plain token transfers and cannot be gated      here; the mint server enforces the same rule when issuing quotes.)

acceptOperator().notice: Complete rotation after the timelock has elapsed.

applyMaxMeltFeeIncrease().notice: Apply a proposed increase after its timelock.

decreaseMaxMeltFee(uint256).notice: Lower the melt-fee ceiling — user-favorable, takes effect instantly.

ecashMelt(address,uint256,bytes32).notice: Operator-authorized payout for a melt. MUST NOT be pausable.

ecashMint(uint256,bytes32).notice: Pull `amount` of the backing token (requires prior approve) and         bind it to a mint quote. Reverts while deposits are paused.

info().notice: One-call discovery + solvency read: everything a client needs         to find the mint and judge its backing.

isPublicationDue().notice: SOFT policy trigger: overdue per the interval rule, OR the         threshold rule is set and the backing balance has drifted more         than `publishThresholdBps` since the last publication. The         operator's publish job polls this.

isPublicationOverdue().notice: HARD policy breach: the interval rule is set and more than         `publishIntervalBlocks` blocks have passed since the last         publication (or none was ever made). While overdue, allowance         deposits (`ecashMint`) revert — a mint that stops attesting         stops taking new money. Withdrawals are never affected.

maxMeltFee().notice: The mint MUST NOT quote a melt fee above this (base units).

meltPaid(bytes32).notice: One payout per melt id, forever.

proposeMaxMeltFeeIncrease(uint256).notice: Propose raising the melt-fee ceiling; applies only after the         rotation timelock elapses. Raising the exit tax requires public notice.

proposeOperator(address).notice: Begin timelocked rotation to a new operator key.

publishOutstandingSupply(bytes8,uint256).notice: Publish outstanding token supply for a keyset (proof of liabilities).         `keysetId` is the mint's 8-byte keyset id.

publishThresholdBps().notice: Publish when balance drifts more than this many bps since the last publication (0 = unset).

setActiveKeyset(bytes8).notice: Advertise the mint's active keyset (call on rotation).

setDepositsPaused(bool).notice: Pause/unpause deposits only. There is deliberately no         corresponding control for withdrawals.

setMintInfo(string,string).notice: Update the mint's discovery metadata (name, API base URL).

sweep(address,address).notice: Return tokens mistakenly sent to the vault. The backing token         is structurally unsweepable — custody can never leave via this         path, only strangers' mistakes can be undone.
